title: Stick to Your Strengths

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Hey, hey how's it going over at Thaddeus's place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey how's it going over at Thaddeus's place?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: I expected that. Based on our previous conversations I mean. Still, good to see your head is still above water... barely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I expected that. Based on our previous conversations I mean. Still, good to see your head is still above water... barely.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Spoken like a Corpster. Too bad you'll never gain that kind of prominence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spoken like a Corpster. Too bad you'll never gain that kind of prominence.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Careful. Them be fightin' words. You haven't been around the block long enough to strap on a pair of gloves and start swingin'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Careful. Them be fightin' words. You haven't been around the block long enough to strap on a pair of gloves and start swingin'.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Long as you stick to food and don't try to encroach on libations then you'll go out of business naturally. That's a much nicer process than the alternative.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Long as you stick to food and don't try to encroach on libations then you'll go out of business naturally. That's a much nicer process than the alternative.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Ask your Automata.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ask your Automata.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Libations are drinks. Historically they are drinks that are poured out as an offering to a deity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Libations are drinks. Historically they are drinks that are poured out as an offering to a deity.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Well, I could burn your restaurant to the ground. Or I could call in a health inspector complaint - what's that? A dead body in your freezer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I could burn your restaurant to the ground. Or I could call in a health inspector complaint - what's that? A dead body in your freezer?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Threatening? I'm simply engaging you in a dialogue about the competitive nature of our separate business ventures. You seem to get off on trying to incite people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Threatening? I'm simply engaging you in a dialogue about the competitive nature of our separate business ventures. You seem to get off on trying to incite people.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: I'll appreciate the influx of customers when you fail and succumb to the debt courts. Don't worry, I'll see what I can do to speed that process along for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll appreciate the influx of customers when you fail and succumb to the debt courts. Don't worry, I'll see what I can do to speed that process along for you.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Now listen up gutter chef, I make the drinks round here. There's no place that makes more unique mixes than the bars I run so don't even try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now listen up gutter chef, I make the drinks round here. There's no place that makes more unique mixes than the bars I run so don't even try.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean my place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean my place.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Better than your spots.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Better than your spots.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's been better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's been better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I bet I'm doing better than you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I bet I'm doing better than you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I bet I'm doing better than you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I bet I'm doing better than you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you customer numbers declining? Or are you here because you like how I smell?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you customer numbers declining? Or are you here because you like how I smell?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you customer numbers declining? Or are you here because you like how I smell?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you customer numbers declining? Or are you here because you like how I smell?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't fight with my hands, just my... food.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't fight with my hands, just my... food.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't fight with my hands, just my... food.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't fight with my hands, just my... food.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Libations?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Libations?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you threatening me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you threatening me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I'll add a new cocktail to the menu.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I'll add a new cocktail to the menu.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I'll add a new cocktail to the menu.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I'll add a new cocktail to the menu.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Scared of a little competition?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Scared of a little competition?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I got some recipes that might make a splash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got some recipes that might make a splash.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I got some recipes that might make a splash.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I got some recipes that might make a splash.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I let my business do the talking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I let my business do the talking.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I let my business do the talking.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I let my business do the talking.
